units.title: Greetings & introductions
units.goal: Introduce yourself, ask someone’s name and greet or say goodbye politely

units.title: About you
units.goal: Give your age, origin and home city, and ask for basic personal information

units.title: At the café
units.goal: Order a simple breakfast, express hunger and ask for the bill

units.title: Numbers & prices
units.goal: Ask a price, understand a small total and say how many items you want

units.title: Family & people
units.goal: Introduce close family members and describe someone simply

units.title: Everyday objects
units.goal: Identify a personal object, describe it and say where it is

units.title: Around town
units.goal: Ask where a place is and follow a simple direction to get there

units.title: Routines & meeting times
units.goal: Say when a daily activity happens and agree a simple meeting time

units.title: Free time & preferences
units.goal: Describe what you enjoy and choose a simple activity with a friend

units.title: Inviting & responding
units.goal: Invite a friend out, accept or decline politely and suggest another time

units.title: Making plans
units.goal: Say what you are going to do and agree a day, time and meeting place

units.title: Choosing clothes
units.goal: Describe clothes and explain which colour, size or item you need

units.title: In the clothes shop
units.goal: Ask to try on clothes, explain the fit and make a simple purchase

units.title: At home
units.goal: Describe rooms and furniture and help a visitor find something at home

units.title: A typical day
units.goal: Describe your daily routine using simple reflexive verbs and times

units.title: A day together
units.goal: Connect a routine, a reason and a future plan in a short practical message

units.title: This week so far
units.goal: Share a recent experience and ask what a friend has done

units.title: Last weekend
units.goal: Describe a finished weekend using a few clear past events

units.title: Choosing the journey
units.goal: Compare transport options and buy a suitable ticket

units.title: Booking a place to stay
units.goal: Ask about a room and confirm a simple accommodation booking

units.title: Arriving and solving a problem
units.goal: Check in and explain a simple problem with a journey or room

units.title: How you feel
units.goal: Explain basic symptoms and say what you need

units.title: Asking for health help
units.goal: Request basic help at a pharmacy and understand a simple instruction

units.title: A useful travel message
units.goal: Link a recent experience, a reason and a practical next plan

units.title: How things used to be
units.goal: Describe past routines and what a familiar place or person was like
units.grammar: Imperfect meaning: background, repeated routines and descriptions; era, tenía, vivía, trabajaba, estudiaba, iba, hacía

units.title: What happened
units.goal: Explain a completed event against familiar past background
units.grammar: Preterite/imperfect meaning contrast; regular -ER/-IR completed events, comí, viví, salí

units.title: Getting around
units.goal: Clarify directions and explain a missed connection or travel delay
units.grammar: Multi-step directions, travel problems; perdí, tuve, pude against estaba

units.title: Eating out
units.goal: Order several items, ask about ingredients and resolve a simple restaurant problem
units.grammar: Quantities, ingredients, missing orders, polite requests; reported completed dijo

units.title: Shopping and everyday services
units.goal: Explain a faulty purchase and request an exchange using a receipt
units.grammar: Returns, comparisons, vine and quise in particular completed service encounters

units.title: Plans change
units.goal: Explain a changed arrangement and propose a practical alternative
units.grammar: Past causes, arrangements and ir a plans; estuve, pude, así que

units.title: What do you think?
units.goal: Give a simple opinion, explain a preference and disagree politely
units.grammar: Creo que, pienso que, me parece, para mí; agreement, también/tampoco; vi

units.title: A day that did not go to plan
units.goal: Tell a short connected account and explain the problem, response and next plan
units.grammar: Synthesis: background versus events, recent experience, present needs, opinions, reasons and practical plans

units.title: Telling the story
units.goal: Narrate an unexpected event with background, sequence and outcome
units.grammar: Past integration; primero, mientras, de repente, al final

units.title: Things that have changed
units.goal: Compare past and present habits and explain how long a change has lasted
units.grammar: Antes/ahora, ya no, todavía, desde, desde hace, hace… que

units.title: Plans and intentions
units.goal: Explain plans, arrangements and future commitments
units.grammar: Simple future iré, tendré, haré, podré; ir a; present arrangements

units.title: Advice and solutions
units.goal: Offer practical advice while respecting the other person’s choice
units.grammar: Conditional advice deberías/podrías; yo que tú; no hace falta; obligation

units.title: Experiences and reactions
units.goal: Describe an experience and explain a personal reaction
units.grammar: Me sorprendió/preocupó/encantó; me pareció; lo pasé; tenía ganas de

units.title: Explaining your view
units.goal: Express a view, support it and acknowledge a different advantage
units.grammar: Creo/pienso/me parece que; por una parte; sin embargo; por eso; por/para

units.title: When things go wrong
units.goal: Clarify a less predictable service problem and negotiate a practical solution
units.grammar: Communication repair; delivery/booking/lost-property problems; polite clarification

units.title: A week to remember
units.goal: Sustain a short connected account integrating events, reactions, reasons and changed plans
units.grammar: B1.1 synthesis: tense meaning, future, conditional advice, viewpoint

units.title: People and relationships
units.goal: Explain an interpersonal misunderstanding and agree a constructive response
units.grammar: Llevarse bien, confiar en, misunderstandings; por/para consolidation

units.title: Work and study
units.goal: Explain responsibilities, experience and a reasoned work/study decision
units.grammar: Responsibilities, applications, collaboration; desde/experience; clear formal requests

units.title: Media and technology
units.goal: Explain technology habits, weigh benefits and resolve a familiar digital problem
units.grammar: Instructions, se puede; advantages/disadvantages; reasons and clarification

units.title: Health and wellbeing
units.goal: Explain a health history and daily habits, and seek appropriate help
units.grammar: Symptoms over time; practical advice; avoiding medical claims

units.title: Travel and culture
units.goal: Recommend a visit with reasons, practical limits and cultural observations
units.grammar: Experiences, comparisons, recommendations; avoiding generalisations

units.title: Hopes and hypotheticals
units.goal: Describe an imagined possibility and a desired change without presenting it as fact
units.grammar: Conditional gustaría/sería/podría/haría/iría; hypothetical context without full si paradigms

units.title: Wishes, reactions and necessity
units.goal: Express a wish, reaction or necessity involving another person
units.grammar: Limited present subjunctive after quiero que, espero que, es importante que, me alegra que; subject changes

units.title: Making your case
units.goal: Sustain an opinion with experience, a response to another view and a solution
units.grammar: B1 synthesis; examples, reasons, polite response, proposals and limited subjunctive

units.title: Stories with detail
units.goal: Relate a detailed account while distinguishing chronology, background and viewpoint
units.grammar: Past integration; limited pluperfect for a prior event; narrator perspective

units.title: Causes and consequences
units.goal: Explain a chain of causes and consequences without overstating what the evidence proves
units.grammar: Debido a, a causa de, por lo tanto, como resultado; cause versus correlation

units.title: Certainty, doubt and possibility
units.goal: Separate what is known, believed and possible when explaining a situation
units.grammar: Probablemente/quizá; puede que; es posible que; no creo que + present subjunctive

units.title: Giving and defending opinions
units.goal: Defend a position with qualification, a counterpoint and relevant support
units.grammar: Polite disagreement; si bien, aunque, sin embargo; partial agreement; support scope

units.title: Formal everyday communication
units.goal: Write a clear enquiry or complaint with relevant evidence and a reasonable request
units.grammar: Register; le agradecería; quisiera; formal structure; specific remedy

units.title: News, media and information
units.goal: Summarise a source accurately and distinguish fact, reported claim and viewpoint
units.grammar: Source attribution; dice que/dijo que; direct versus reported information; no automatic tense backshift

units.title: Hypothetical situations
units.goal: Explain an imagined present alternative and its likely consequences
units.grammar: Si + imperfect subjunctive; conditional result; real/open si + indicative

units.title: Discussing a problem
units.goal: Explain a problem, compare options and recommend a solution responsive to another view
units.grammar: Integrated argument: cause, evidence, options, consequences, conditional proposal

units.title: Viewpoint and perspective
units.goal: Qualify a position, acknowledge another perspective and identify evidence limits
units.grammar: Hasta cierto punto; desde mi punto de vista; no necesariamente; certainty and scope

units.title: Complex narration
units.goal: Produce an extended account linking earlier events, reactions, consequences and reflection
units.grammar: Pluperfect and tense integration; conditional perfect reflection; chronology versus viewpoint

units.title: Argument and counterargument
units.goal: Develop a supported position, engage with an objection and qualify the conclusion
units.grammar: Position, evidence, concession, counterargument and bounded conclusion

units.title: Social and cultural topics
units.goal: Discuss familiar social choices with evidence, perspectives and practical consequences
units.grammar: Accessible social topics; generalisation, comparison and trade-offs

units.title: Formal and informal register
units.goal: Adapt a truthful message to its recipient without losing essential facts
units.grammar: Recipient, greeting, request, degree of formality and closing

units.title: Reported speech and information
units.goal: Relay claims accurately, attribute perspectives and retain uncertainty
units.grammar: Reporting verbs, source attribution, reference time and qualified paraphrase

units.title: Possibility, condition and consequence
units.goal: Explain real and imagined conditions, distinguish uncertainty and reflect on past alternatives
units.grammar: Real/open conditions; imagined present and past; conditional perfect; limited perfect subjunctive

units.title: The B2 project
units.goal: Integrate narration, explanation, evidence, perspectives and a practical proposal for real recipients
units.grammar: Integrated extended communication; revision, register and evidence limits

performance.environment: Node v24.19.0 Linux execution workspace; ten iterations, all course activities completed, 200 review snapshots and active B2 story; not physical Android/browser timing

thirdPartyContent: None added; original first-party material only
